name: Bad Neighbor
summary:
Welcome to Bad Neighbor!

The neighborhood kids are always up to something, and your peaceful day is about to become anything but peaceful. They ring your doorbell and run, make a mess, sneak around your house, steal things, and come up with new ways to cause trouble.

It's up to you to figure out what they're planning, catch them in the act, and outsmart their mischievous tricks.

Explore your home and surroundings, interact with everyday objects, discover what the kids are doing, and use your surroundings
